title: Jain authority-bind evidence record
description: Machine-checkable shape of one bound member's lifecycle evidence, as recorded per batch under docs/release-evidence/10.0.0/authority-binds-*.md. Every field is independently verifiable against the authenticated forge: main and the immutable tag must resolve to release_commit; release_tree is commit^{tree}; archive_sha256 is sha256 of `git archive --format=tar <commit>`, the same derivation splitctl applies in its exactness check.

route.description: Distinct identities of the reviewed route; author, reviewer and merger must all differ.
